notes: New History button next to the Watchlist button in the Companies panel. Click it to open a browser that lists all tickers; pick one to see the start and end price of each 30-minute market cycle for the last ~5 months, newest first. The archive starts empty on this update and fills forward one row per ticker per cycle, so it reaches full 5-month depth about five months from now. Carries 1.1.8.6 and earlier.
